title: Appraisal Desk Note: Appraisal Age and the Successor Response Window in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Age of the appraisal.** For the successor's notices on a Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the age of the case's as-is appraisal is the number of whole calendar months from the appraisal date to the mailing date. An appraisal dated after the mailing date counts as less than 4 months old.

**Rule.**

- Where the case has no appraisal recorded, 15 days are added to the window count.
- Where the appraisal is at least the plan's appraisal validity in months old, 10 days are added. That validity is 6 months under every plan.
- Where it is at least 4 and less than the plan's appraisal validity in months old, 5 days are added.
- Where it is less than 4 months old, nothing is added.

## Schedule

| Appraisal on the case at mailing | Days added to the window count |
|---|---|
| none recorded | 15 |
| 6 whole months old or more | 10 |
| 4 or 5 whole months old | 5 |
| under 4 whole months old, or dated after the mailing date | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, mailing on 15 September)

| Appraisal date | Whole months to mailing | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| 16 May | 3 | 0 |
| 15 May | 4 | 5 |
| 16 March | 5 | 5 |
| 15 March | 6 | 10 |
